text: can you add imagebased backdrops on the @cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Studio.tsx so i can trace it while modeling
resolution: Added image-based reference backdrops to the Studio mesh editor so you can trace blueprints/photos while modeling. New cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Backdrops.tsx renders each backdrop as a double-sided translucent quad on a chosen cardinal plane (front/back/left/right/top/bottom), textured through Scene3D's existing image path (offscreen StaticSurface -> Mesh textureKey, the same mechanism the sprite atlas uses) and routed to the back-to-front transparent pass so the grid + model read through it. A toolbar 'trace' toggle opens a setup panel with per-backdrop plane picker + live size/offset/opacity/flip sliders + show/hide/remove. Backdrops are twig state (survive hot reload, reset cold), like the scale ghost. Studio.tsx wires the state, loader, and render. Pure TSX (hot-reloadable). Verified: bundle + native build clean, /model route self-shot PASS.
